# Rule B6: End-of-round griefing (EORG) Roleplay does not end at evac. Attacking, destroying, polluting or severely injuring both at and on the way to Midpoint is not allowed without sufficient reason (see [textlink="B1.4" link="DeltaVRule1"], [textlink="B4" link="DeltaVRule4"]).
Causing mass casualties or using tactics that have the potential to cause mass casualties is never allowed. Such tactics may include bombing, spacing or placing turrets at the end of the round.
Violations of this rule are generally met with a 2-hour ban. Depending on severity and player history, punishment may be escalated in accordance with administrative policy.
## Rule B6.1: EORG Exceptions Round-ending antagonists are exempt from rule B6, [color=#ffDD00]if they are acting in pursuit of an objective[/color]. [textlink="Rule C3.2" link="DeltaVRuleC3"] contains a list of round-ending antagonists.
